analysis: The only change in this PR is to test expectations in provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/NemotronSuperServingPolicyTests.swift (head lines 297-298, 305, 324). It updates comment text and expected default prefix-bank sizes: [12<<28, 34<<28, ...] becomes [10<<28, 32<<28, ...] for the 34 and 45 GiB grants, and 22<<29/29<<28 becomes 21<<29/27<<28 for the 50 GiB grant with the 2048/4096-token chunk lanes. These are smaller values, so the tests now expect a slightly more conservative in-memory prefix bank. No production code is in the supplied diff, so no trust boundary, key handling, attestation, authorization, or cache scoping logic changes here. The at-rest cache posture in T-041 (HMAC-keyed names, TTL, salt scoping) is untouched. The bank sizing relates to memory admission and availability (T-029/T-041 adjacent), and the tests assert bounds such as bank <= quarter of grant, 2*bank <= slack, and cap fit, which remain intact. Remaining integration question: the matching production change in NemotronSuperServingPolicy.defaultPrefixBankBytes is not supplied. I could not verify that it matches these new expectations or that it does not weaken the memory-cap invariants the tests assert. That is a coverage limit, not evidence of a regression.
